d:
Some places have histories that are difficult to forget, and even harder to investigate. In Ghost Adventures, Zak Bagans and his crew enter locations known for disturbing pasts, unexplained occurrences and reports of paranormal activity.
From a legendary ocean liner and an infamous mansion to a cave linked to a chilling legend and an abandoned sanatorium, each investigation takes the crew into places where the past seems far from over. But what will they encounter when they step inside?
Watch Ghost Adventures, Season 10, Episodes 13, 1, 10, 5, 3, 7 & 2 on Discovery Channel India.
